chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Abdullah ibn al-Hasan al-Mu'addib narrated to us from Ahmad ibn 'Ali al-Isfahani, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Muhammad ibn Dawud al-Dinawari narrated to us. He said: Mundhir al-'Ishrani narrated to us. He said: Sa'id ibn Zayd narrated to us from Abu Qanbal, from Abu'l-Jarud, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). He said:
"Verily, the ring knocker of the gate of Paradise is made from a red ruby upon sheets of gold. When the ring strikes the plate, it chimes and calls out: 'O Ali!'"

key_terms.حَلْقَة: Ring/knocker — the door-ring or knocker used to announce one's arrival
key_terms.صَفَائِح الذَّهَب: Sheets of gold — gold plates or panels, indicating celestial opulence
key_terms.طَنَّتْ: It chimed/rang — the resonant metallic sound of the ring on the plate
key_terms.يَاقُوتَة: Ruby — a precious red gemstone, symbolizing divine splendor

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about the door-ring of Paradise and the name of Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain ending with the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) via Ibn 'Abbas, describes a miraculous cosmological detail about Paradise: its door-ring is fashioned from a red ruby set upon golden plates, and when struck, it produces a ringing sound and calls out the name of 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him). This narration is characteristic of the Amali genre — oral dictation sessions — of Shaykh al-Saduq (d. 381 AH), and reflects the Shia tradition of emphasizing the unique, divinely sanctioned station of Imam 'Ali through eschatological and cosmological narratives. The hadith would have been understood by its original audience as affirming that 'Ali's name is inscribed in the very fabric of the afterlife.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Muhammad b. Dawud al-Dinuri narrated to us. He said: Mundhir al-`Ishrani narrated to us. He said: Sa`id b. Zayd narrated to us from Abi Qanbal from Abi’l Jarud from Sa`id b. Jubayr from Ibn `Abbas from the Prophet (s). He said:
The ring pull on the gate of Paradise is made from ruby, and it is upon sheets of gold. When the ring pull knocks on the sheet, it chimes and says: “O `Ali (ya `Ali).”
